components.name: Opening-range levels

definition.summary: Causal high, low, midpoint, and width of a complete opening interval under an explicit bar-timestamp convention.

timing.availability: After the final configured opening-range bar is complete

components.notes: The reusable definition is independent of MNQ; timestamp/session configuration is supplied by the dataset and instrument binding.

components.name: Opening-range width

definition.summary: Absolute distance between opening-range high and low.

components.notes: OR width is a validated feature and a potential future state feature; it is not an established regime variable or approved strategy filter.

components.name: Opening-range breakout event

definition.summary: Directional event emitted when configured PRINT or CLOSE conditions cross a complete opening-range boundary.

timing.availability: At or after the first eligible post-range bar under the configured event definition

components.notes: Signal records remain independent from whether execution accepts a candidate trade.

components.name: Opening Range Breakout V0.1 reference strategy

definition.summary: Reference composition of opening-range features and breakout signals with versioned eligibility, execution, and risk rules.

timing.availability: Defined by the bound signal and execution contracts

components.notes: MNQ ORB V0.1 is the first project binding and reference implementation, not the architectural definition of the platform.

components.name: Price-normalized distance

definition.summary: Decimal representation of a raw point distance divided by an explicitly recorded causal reference price.

timing.availability: No earlier than both numerator and denominator

components.notes: 0.0035 means 0.35%. Session/window ranges use window open; OR features use OR open; key-level distances use OR midpoint.

components.name: Opening-range context

definition.summary: Causal OR OHLC, width, normalized width, net move, efficiency, CLV, direction, and extrema timestamps.

timing.availability: At the configured OR completion bar-end

components.notes: timestamp_et is bar_end_time. OR bars begin at 09:31 ET.

components.name: Causal historical OR-width context

definition.summary: Same-duration trailing OR-width midrank percentile and population z-score using prior sessions only.

timing.availability: At current OR completion after full prior-session warm-up

components.notes: The current session never enters its own historical distribution; the 5/10/15/20 family is a feature representation and no lookback is selected as best.

components.name: Pre-open context windows

definition.summary: Raw and normalized OHLC/range/movement context for approved Asia, London, New York pre-market, Globex overnight, and continuous 20:00-09:00 overnight-context windows.

timing.availability: At each configured window end; New York pre-market is available at 09:00 ET

components.notes: NY PM means New York pre-market. Human-validated and Stage-2 frozen on 2026-09-02: Asia 20:00-00:00, London 02:00-05:00, and New York pre-market 07:00-09:00 ET. combined_preopen migrated to OVERNIGHT_CONTEXT_2000_0900.

components.name: Globex reopen gap

definition.summary: Gap from prior trading-session 17:00 bar close to the following session's 18:01 bar open, with fill state observed causally through 09:30.

components.notes: No information after the 09:30 bar-end is used.

components.name: Previous full futures trading-day levels

definition.summary: High, low, and close of the complete prior futures trading day under the dataset's CME session_date ownership convention.
inputs: prior session-owned OHLC bars stamped prior-calendar-day 18:01 through trading-date 17:00

timing.availability: After the prior trading day's 17:00 bar-end

components.notes: These are the primary generic prior-day references. Previous RTH levels remain separately available and optional. Incomplete prior trading days remain unavailable.

components.name: New York open gap

definition.summary: Difference between the prior trading day's 16:14 bar close and the current 09:31 bar open, which is the 09:30 New York opening price under NT8 bar-end labels.

timing.availability: 09:31 ET bar-end; the opening price itself refers to 09:30:00

components.notes: A missing 16:14 or 09:31 bar makes the feature unavailable; no alternate close or open is substituted. This is distinct from GLOBEX_REOPEN_GAP.

components.name: Opening-range key-level interaction

definition.summary: Signed OR-to-level distances plus deterministic touch, trade-through, sweep, close-through, and rejection states.

components.notes: A sweep is a strict trade beyond a level followed by an OR close on the OR-open side; rejection includes a touch and close on that side.

components.name: Pre-open liquidity path events

definition.summary: Boolean and categorical records of later pre-open windows trading beyond earlier-window highs or lows.

timing.availability: 09:00 ET after New York pre-market completion

components.notes: Event/state features only; no bullish/bearish or strategy interpretation. Human visual review passed and the feature is Stage-2 frozen as of 2026-09-02. Signal-bar excursion remains documented separately in the registered outcome contract because it is an outcome label, not a reusable causal component.
